level: two standalone channel programs and a tested frame protocol; executed on this host and on QEMU, not on two boards

protocol.crc: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over the ASCII characters before the CRC word
protocol.request: 4C535251 version sequence kernel_id(2) nargs args(8) crc
protocol.response: 4C535253 version sequence kernel_id(2) channel nargs args(8) status cause result cycles crc
